timing_policy: Recorded scoped measurements only. No extrapolation, row sums, algorithm speedups or exclusive-hardware claims.
limitations: Shared host and GPUs, including overlapping benchmark processes; not a controlled device speed-ratio study
DDSeg: one warmup per device, one CPU timed repeat at 16 threads and three CUDA repeats; other methods: one fresh run per device
Interrupted four-thread DDSeg and DDParcel runs are excluded, not extrapolated
Output agreement is not ground-truth accuracy or human anatomical acceptance
